summary: Ultra Nova created a space simulation game called Mission Designer. In Mission Designer players can design their rockets and satellites for many different space missions. In Mission Designer players can choose parts customize their designs and manage their budget while keeping costs low. When Mission Designer is ready players can run a simulation to see if Mission Designer succeeds or fails. The results of Mission Designer depend on factors such, as whether Mission Designer has fuel whether Mission Designer is too heavy and whether Mission Designer can reach orbit. Mission Designer also offers possible endings depending on how well Mission Designer is designed and planned.
details:
What does it do or how does it work?

Mission Designer lets players build their own rockets and satellites. They can change things like fuel, size, and parts, then run a simulation to see if their rocket reaches orbit or fails.

What benefits does it have?

It teaches players how rockets work and how things like fuel, weight, and air resistance affect a launch. Players can experiment with different designs and learn from their mistakes.

What is the intended impact of the project?

We want Mission Designer to make learning about rockets and space more fun. Players can see how their choices affect a mission and what makes a launch succeed or fail.

What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use?

We used Claude to create the first version of the game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Then we used VS Code to edit the code and improve the game.

How is your project creative?

Players can build their own rockets and satellites however they want. They can change the size, fuel, and parts to see what works best. There are also different endings depending on how their mission goes.

What factors did your team consider?

At first, we wanted players to land on Mars or the Moon, but we later changed the idea to landing back on Earth in the ocean. We also considered fuel, weight, aerodynamics, and budget when designing the game.
